\newcommand{\ovalphoto}[1]{%
  \begin{tikzpicture}
    \begin{scope}
      \clip (0,0) ellipse (1.0cm and 1.22cm);
      \node[inner sep=0] at (0,0){\includegraphics[width=2.0cm]{#1}};
    \end{scope}
    \draw[sidesubtle, line width=0.5pt] (0,0) ellipse (1.0cm and 1.22cm);
  \end{tikzpicture}%
}

\newcommand{\sidesection}[1]{%
  \vspace{8pt}%
  {\color{white}\footnotesize\bfseries\MakeUppercase{#1}}\\[-2pt]%
  {\color{crimson}\rule{\linewidth}{0.35pt}}\\[4pt]%
}

\newcommand{\sidecontact}[1]{%
  {\color{sidetext}\footnotesize #1}\\[3.5pt]%
}

\newcommand{\sideskillcat}[1]{%
  \vspace{5pt}%
  {\color{white}\footnotesize\bfseries #1}\\[2pt]%
}

\newcommand{\sideskillitem}[1]{%
  \hspace{5pt}{\color{crimson}\tiny\textbullet}\enspace{\color{sidesubtle}\footnotesize #1}\\[2.5pt]%
}

\newcommand{\sidecertitem}[1]{%
  {\color{crimson}\tiny\textbullet}\enspace{\color{sidetext}\footnotesize #1}\\[3.5pt]%
}

\newcommand{\sidelangitem}[2]{%
  {\color{white}\footnotesize\textbf{#1}}\enspace{\color{sidesubtle}\footnotesize #2}\\[3pt]%
}

\newcommand{\entrytitle}[4]{%
  \noindent
  \begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}X r@{}}
    \textbf{#1} & \textcolor{medgray}{\small #4}\\[1pt]
    \textcolor{medgray}{\small\itshape #2} & \textcolor{medgray}{\small #3}
  \end{tabularx}%
  \nopagebreak[4]%
}

\newcommand{\entrytitlesimple}[3]{%
  \noindent
  \begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}X r@{}}
    \textbf{#1} & \textcolor{medgray}{\small #3}\\[1pt]
    \ifthenelse{\equal{#2}{}}{}{\textcolor{medgray}{\small\itshape #2}} &
  \end{tabularx}%
  \nopagebreak[4]%
}

\newcommand{\educationentry}[4]{%
  \noindent
  \begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}X r@{}}
    \textbf{#1} & \textcolor{medgray}{\small #3}\\[1pt]
    \textcolor{medgray}{\small\itshape #2} & \textcolor{medgray}{\small #4}
  \end{tabularx}%
  \vspace{6pt}%
}

\newcommand{\summaryblock}[1]{%
  {\small\setlength{\parskip}{4pt}#1}\vspace{4pt}%
}
